title: October 2026 — In progress
serviceIntro: We support Melissa Jean Art with marketing guidance and practical Shopify improvements that help customers explore the artwork and shop with confidence.
monthlyRecap: Report in progress — this is the start of Melissa Jean Art’s October report. Leanne’s work has focused mainly on marketing consultation, with further website work still planned. We’ll add those updates once completed.

On October 27, we completed two Shopify updates: displaying full artwork images in the Originals and Prints collections, and updating the prints collection so all 29 current prints appear on the first page. Melissa reviewed the changes and confirmed she was happy with the result.

technicalSeo.completedWorkHtml:
The ten entries below describe the tasks within two completed Shopify updates, not ten separate projects. All were completed on October 27, 2026. Other collection templates were left unchanged.

DateUpdateWork completed
October 27, 2026Artwork displayUpdated the Originals collection thumbnails to show each artwork’s full image.
October 27, 2026Artwork displayUpdated the Prints collection thumbnails to show each artwork’s full image.
October 27, 2026Artwork displayPreserved artwork proportions so customers can distinguish horizontal, vertical and square pieces.
October 27, 2026Artwork displayRemoved the square cropping that previously obscured parts of the artwork.
October 27, 2026Artwork displayPublished the approved artwork display changes to the live Shopify theme.
October 27, 2026Prints collectionCreated a dedicated collection template for canvas prints.
October 27, 2026Prints collectionAssigned the new template to the prints collection.
October 27, 2026Prints collectionIncreased the prints collection’s page limit to 36 products.
October 27, 2026Prints collectionVerified that all 29 current prints appeared on the first page, eliminating the need to browse a second page.
October 27, 2026Client reviewSent the completed updates to Melissa for review and received her confirmation: “That’s perfect!! Thank you!”
